message: The other day, I was chatting with my buddy about smoke alarms and how I always test mine every month. He laughed and said it was overkill. Fast forward to dinner last night when his alarm went off while he was burning dinner! I couldn’t help but give a little smug ‘I told you so’ grin. It’s funny how a small habit can save us from a smoky kitchen disaster. Just a friendly nudge to check those alarms, folks! 🔥
